projection: OpenCV fisheye, ideal equidistant FOV fit
intrinsics_status: Derived from ELP nominal horizontal/vertical FOV at 640x480 under an ideal equidistant prior; not measured for either physical camera. ELP does not specify VGA crop or unit-specific distortion.

sensor_native.status: OV2710 native active pixel count and OMNIVISION pixel pitch; VGA crop/resampling is not published

usd_optics_status: Paraxial metadata estimate from native sensor width and fitted horizontal fx. Isaac's fisheye schema, not these USD camera fields, controls ray projection.

nominal_mount_in_yubi_frame.status: Optical center and forward axis estimated from official v2 motorized assembly STEP. The 180 degree image roll aligns the simulated wrist image-up convention with all five replay sets; sensor roll was not measured from CAD. Validate each physical camera with hand-eye calibration.

simulator_recording_status: The runner samples RGB and joint states at 30 Hz by default while policy actions remain at 10 Hz and physics runs at 60 Hz; this matches source video timing, not the module's 100 fps VGA maximum
